title: Finite Lipschitz lacunary series separate points at a prescribed scale
source_title: Schweitzer Miklós Matematikai Emlékverseny 2025 — Feladatsor és megoldások

difficulty_reason: The author places a single periodic bump around one orbit point, controlling the tail by a geometric cutoff when no iterate hits it and using an exact scaled-tail identity when it is hit. Compactness then makes the local witnesses a finite family with a D-independent gap.

dedup.scope: The focused current SQL title/key and exact arXiv identity retrieval has no same-target row. Buczolich–Käenmäki–Maga arXiv:2507.15591v1 Theorem 2.1 gives a stronger all-scale bi-Hölder Weierstrass embedding using another construction. With b=3 it implies separation on each D-scale, but its gap is proportional to D^α; Problem 8 permits a D-dependent family and gives a fixed gap depending only on α.

readability.basis: Full printed statement and selected author solution in the fixed annual report. Original Hungarian statement sheet separately cross-checked.

source_caveats: The printed Lemma 2 says arbitrary x,y. At congruent x,y the inequality is false; the proof itself separates non-hit and first hit at k0≥1, and the compact set used for the stated problem has positive distance D. Retain the text and distinguish the lemma's actual off-diagonal use.
